en-US.longDescription: Fast, cross-platform email designed to filter out the noise - so you can focus on what's important.
en-US.name: Spark Desktop
en-US.releaseNotes:
In this update:
- Fixed an issue where Outlook and Microsoft 365 calendars could show recurring events on the wrong day, create duplicate events, receive cancellations late, or never finish syncing large calendars.
- Fixed an issue where overlapping calendar events weren’t displayed correctly.
- Fixed an issue where Spark could crash on launch on some Windows PCs.
- Fixed an issue where Spark could freeze on Mac when snoozed emails returned to large Outlook and Microsoft 365 accounts.
- Fixed an issue where replying with the inline Send button didn’t mark the conversation as done, even with “Mark conversation as done after replying” turned on.
- Fixed an issue where comments and read statuses could be missing or covered by the Assistant in full-screen and split views.
- Fixed an issue where swipes, Select All actions, and deleting selected emails didn’t always work as expected.
- Fixed an issue where some IMAP accounts on Windows couldn’t sync and Greek text in some emails appeared garbled.
We’re always here for you at support@sparkmailapp.com

P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.32.3.141489/Spark.dmg
